newsitem.title: INDIA: India Punjab cotton prices rise on lower arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India Punjab cotton prices rise on lower arrivals.

text.p: India's Punjab cotton prices bounced back on Monday on lower arrivals due to this week's polls in the region, dealers said.

In spot deals Punjab saw-ginned moved up by 30 rupees to 1,400/1,620 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while F-414 rose by 25/30 rupees to 1,800/1,825 rupees. Bengal-deshi was up by 25/35 rupees to 800/840 rupees per maund.
Gujarat cotton on the other hand remained subdued on low mill demand and continued inflow. Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 100/200 rupees to 11,200/11,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
"Overall volume was low but sentiment was firm at the close on expectation that the government may allow more export of cotton," one broker said.
